changes.to: Proposal (claude-loop3, 2026-10-25): words and frequencies from Mozilla Common Voice sentence text (CC0, github.com/common-voice/common-voice server/data/<lang>) (hi: only 4 MB of sentences, so ranking is thin), plus AI4Bharat Aksharantar romanized/native word pairs for the loose spellings people type (huggingface.co/datasets/ai4bharat/Aksharantar; mined pairs CC0, hand-collected pairs CC-BY 4.0, which needs an attribution line in the pack licences; hi 1.3 million pairs), plus a sound table for words not in the pairs. Pack estimated 3–6 MB. Not usable: hermitdave FrequencyWords and wordfreq (their word data is CC-BY-SA 4.0), Leipzig corpora (non-commercial).
